dedupe_keys.name: nie networks open data hub grid supply points bulk supply points and primary substations of northern ireland

description: NIE Networks, the transmission owner and distribution operator in Northern Ireland, runs an Open Data Hub on Opendatasoft with 21 datasets, a DSO dashboard, a substation dashboard, map and chart builders and an API, read on 2026-09-26, The site datasets, whose coverage is the whole of Northern Ireland, list Northern Ireland's 10 grid supply points, 47 bulk supply points and 293 primary substations, together 350 sites, each with licence area, site name, functional location, type, voltage, street address, town, county and postcode, Irish Grid coordinates, a geopoint and local authority district; they were modified on the day of reading. Formats offered are CSV, JSON, Excel, GeoJSON, Shapefile and KML. Data are free under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: the site lists hold locations and attributes, not line routes or ratings. Simulation uses are locating substations for network flow models and hazard exposure of Northern Ireland's grid to flooding and storms. Related records: data-sp-energy-networks-open-data-portal and data-uk-power-networks-open-data-portal cover Great Britain operators.
